title: Settings text clipped at small resolution
description: Several options at the bottom of the settings panel are cut off when I switch to a smaller display resolution.

title: Health bar extends beyond screen edge
description: Increasing the interface scale pushes the health bar beyond the right edge of the screen during gameplay.

title: Crafting consumes materials without item
description: The crafting action removes the required materials from the inventory, but the finished item never appears.

title: Item duplicates after moving inventory slot
description: Moving the same item back and forth between inventory slots occasionally creates an additional copy.

title: Save load resets equipped weapon
description: After saving with a different weapon equipped, reloading restores the default weapon instead of the selected one.

title: Menu transition causes long freeze
description: Switching rapidly between inventory and settings sometimes leaves the game unresponsive for a few seconds.

title: Lobby player count differs across clients
description: One player's lobby screen shows a different number of connected players from the count shown by the host.

title: Ready status fails to synchronize
description: The local ready indicator changes correctly, but another player's lobby screen continues to show the old status.

title: Remote player position stops updating
description: A remote character stops moving on screen for several seconds and then suddenly jumps to a new position.

title: Notification sound ignores mute setting
description: The notification tone still plays even after sound effects have been muted in the audio settings.

title: Crafting recipe text uses wrong quantity
description: The crafting panel shows two components required, although the recipe details list three.

title: Language switch leaves untranslated button
description: Selecting another interface language changes the settings labels, but the confirmation button remains in English.

title: Rebinding display fails to update
description: The controls menu accepts a new key assignment, but the help panel continues to display the old key.

title: Subtitle background blocks dialogue choices
description: With large subtitles enabled, the subtitle panel overlays the lowest dialogue response.

title: Character can jump during stun animation
description: A jump input buffered just before a stun triggers a full jump while the character is still shown as stunned.

title: Inventory weight remains after dropping item
description: Dropping a heavy item removes it from the backpack, but the carried weight value does not decrease.

title: Crafting queue finishes without materials
description: Canceling and immediately restarting a craft can produce the item without consuming the required resources.

title: Fall damage occurs after safe landing
description: Walking down a short slope triggers a fall damage event even though the character never leaves the ground.

title: Quest completion fails with full inventory
description: Finishing a delivery quest while the backpack is full leaves the quest marked incomplete even though the item was handed over.

title: Player can equip two exclusive tools
description: Swapping equipment rapidly between two restricted slots allows both exclusive tools to remain active.

title: Respawn ignores last activated checkpoint
description: After activating a new checkpoint and dying, the player respawns at the previous checkpoint.

title: Two players can claim same reward
description: When two clients confirm a shared reward at nearly the same time, both receive the item despite a one item limit.

title: Remote damage arrives twice
description: A guest is hit once by an enemy attack but receives two damage events during temporary packet loss.

title: Party members see different timer values
description: Two players entering the same timed activity see different remaining time values despite joining simultaneously.

title: Autosave causes visible stutter
description: Each autosave produces a short interruption in character movement while the save icon is displayed.

title: Asset loading pauses traversal
description: Moving rapidly between adjacent zones causes terrain objects to appear late and movement to halt briefly.

title: Long play session increases loading times
description: After leaving the game running for several hours, changing areas takes much longer than after a fresh launch.

title: Dialogue voice missing after loading save
description: Loading a save during dialogue resumes subtitles but not the accompanying recorded voice.

title: Water sounds continue on dry land
description: After leaving a river, splash and water ambience continue while the player walks on a stone path.

title: Ambient effects leak through mute
description: Setting ambient audio to zero still leaves environmental wind sounds audible during exploration.

title: Footstep material sound mismatches surface
description: Walking across a wooden bridge plays the same metallic footstep sound heard on a metal floor.

title: Left and right channels reversed for nearby source
description: A sound source standing to the player's left is heard predominantly through the right channel.

title: Audio fades out too early during scene change
description: Background music cuts off before the scene transition finishes, leaving an unexpected silent gap.

title: Language switch leaves one untranslated heading
description: Changing the interface language updates menu options, but the matchmaking heading remains in English until restart.

title: Quest dialogue choice text wraps beneath its icon
description: The last word of a long dialogue option appears underneath the controller prompt rather than on the next line.

title: Accessibility contrast toggle misses confirmation dialog
description: High contrast mode updates the settings pages but not the confirm-deletion window.

title: Gamepad cursor disappears on profile screen
description: The selection highlight vanishes after switching between profiles, even though the buttons can still be activated.

title: Settings slider value shows outdated number
description: Dragging the brightness slider changes the scene immediately, but the numeric label updates only after releasing it.

title: Party invite badge counts dismissed invitations
description: After declining two invites, the badge on the social tab still shows two pending requests.

title: Dropped bag duplicates after reloading checkpoint
description: I recover my dropped inventory after death, reload the checkpoint, and find the same bag on the ground again.

title: Jump height changes after opening inventory
description: Closing the inventory during a jump causes the next jump to travel much farther than usual.

title: Severe stutter when opening the codex first time
description: The first visit to the codex after launching freezes movement for roughly two seconds, while later visits are smooth.

title: Frame pacing degrades with particle storms
description: During an encounter with several smoke effects, the image hitches repeatedly even though the average frame counter stays high.

title: Memory footprint rises when inspecting cosmetics
description: Browsing character skins repeatedly increases reported memory use and the allocation is not released when the menu closes.

title: Long chat history slows social panel
description: After several hundred messages, opening the chat history takes multiple seconds and scrolling becomes jerky.

title: Repeated photo mode toggles increase memory
description: Switching photo mode on and off several times leaves memory use higher on every cycle.

title: Inventory search slows with full storage
description: Typing into the item search field becomes noticeably delayed when the storage chest contains many entries.

title: Equipment preview takes too long after sorting
description: Opening 3D previews of multiple items in quick succession causes several seconds of unresponsive input.

title: Background asset streaming stalls after teleport
description: Teleporting across the map leaves the image frozen while distant environment assets stream in.

title: Party chat stops after switching host
description: When leadership transfers to another player, new chat messages are no longer delivered to guests.

title: Trade confirmation not received by guest
description: Both players approve a trade, but one client stays on the confirmation screen until the timer expires.

title: Remote avatar teleports between updates
description: Another player's position freezes briefly and then jumps across the corridor rather than moving smoothly.

title: Disconnected guest can still vote in party menu
description: A disconnected player's slot remains active and counts toward the next mission vote.

title: Co-op door state differs between players
description: The host can walk through an opened door while a guest still sees it locked and cannot pass.

title: Friend status updates only after restarting
description: An online friend remains listed as offline throughout the session until I relaunch the game.

title: Footsteps continue after climbing ends
description: The climbing sound keeps playing after the character reaches the ledge and starts running.

title: Weapon hit sounds are delayed
description: The sword connects visibly, then the impact sound plays a noticeable moment later.

title: Audio output ignores selected device
description: I choose headphones in the in-game audio menu, but dialogue keeps playing through the speakers.

title: Background music fades out and never returns
description: After leaving a combat encounter, the combat track ends but exploration music does not resume.

title: Achievement audio plays after notifications disabled
description: The notification sounds toggle is off, but unlocking an achievement still produces the chime.
